item.text: I found the hash-join bug. The bucket-address stride was wrong: `base + bucket * OFFSET` makes `R` bucket 1 start at `21000`, which overlaps `S` bucket 0. I’m fixing the bucket layout so each relation’s six bucket regions stay inside its own 1000-address window.

Implemented all hollow units in both apps and completed the required requirement patch workflow. The buffer manager, block I/O helpers, external sort, selection, projection, nested-loop/hash/sort-merge joins, and the query-tree printing/parser/optimizer are now filled in.

Verification: both binaries rebuild successfully. I ran the shipped QueryOptimize sample output, plus `select`, `project`, `nlj`, `hj`, and `smj` on QueryProcessing. `select` returns 6 tuples, `project` emits distinct `A` values `1..40`, and all three joins now produce 303 result tuples. Requirement coverage: reviewed 26, implemented 26, blocked 0.

The source fixes are committed, and the rebuilt executables in `lab/QueryProcessing/build/QueryProcessing` and `lab/QueryOptimize/build/QueryOptimize` are updated in the working tree.
